zfadjrvn.variantName: COSTWAY 6FT Pre-Lit Christmas Tree with 8 Modes LED Lights - Green
zfadjrvn.sourceDescription: Great choice to bring you a lifelike and realistic spruce Christmas tree with 450 /650warm white LED lights and 8 different lighting modes. Perfect for you to set the mood for fireside holiday gatherings and toast-filled holiday parties! The premium 600 /1250PVC branches are strong enough to support your favorite decorations to create a personalized appearance for your home, office, holiday parties, and other places. Moreover, the branches are easy to expand to get a leafy and lush appearance. The metal stand can provide reinforced support for stability. The added non-slip pads on the end of the stand protect your floor and the green painted iron pipe trunk makes this tree look more simulated. Absolutely a great gift to create a strong festive atmosphere! If you are looking for a Christmas tree like this, do not hesitate to place an order! 450/650 LED Lights with 8 Lighting Functions: The pre-lit artificial Christmas tree is equipped with 450/650 warm LED lights of energy-efficient and long-lasting to give a balanced and warm festive glow. Featuring 8 lighting functions, the lights can switch to different lighting modes, lighting up your room with a festive ambience. You just plug into the wall and enjoy the lights shine. Life-like Tree with PVC Branches: Made of high-quality PVC material, the 150/180cm Christmas tree is durable, odorless, non-flammable, and non-allergic for a long life span. Crafted with 600 /1250branch tips with exquisite workmanship, the leaves of the artificial spruce tree show a leafy and fluffy appearance and give a full look of a natural tree. Hinged Design for Easy Setting Up: Designed with the convenient hinged construction, the spruce LED Christmas tree’s body is divided into 2 sections for easy installation and you can also dismantle it for convenient storage and future uses. The branches are easy to open up all around to form a full and fluffy outlook easily. Metal Stand for Stability: Featuring a metal stand with non-slip foot pads, the pre-lit artificial Christmas tree can withstand greater support and balance, securely keeping it standing upright all season long. Moreover, the stand can be folded up to store in the closet. Also, the green-painted iron pipe of the stand makes this tree look more simulated. Perfect for Holiday Decorations: The pre-lit spruce Christmas tree boasts warm white LED lights that can brighten all your holidays. You can put it in your home, office, holiday party, and more to inspire holiday cheer and make the season feel complete. Hang on to your favorite ornaments to create a happy and prosperous festive atmosphere for you. wrg73tsy.sourceDescription: This beautiful artificial hinged Christmas tree is very lifelike in its shape and appearance and is meant to create just the right atmosphere for this Christmas. Hinged construction: The Christmas tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down at the right angle. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape and will save you time as well.Lifelike tips: The Christmas decoration has realistic PVC tips, making the tree lifelike in its shape and appearance.Sturdy stand: The metal stand provides your artificial Christmas tree with optimal sturdiness and stability.Flocked snow design: The Xmas tree has artificial white snow on it, giving an attractive snow-flocked look.Economical choice: You can reuse the Christmas ornament every year, which is a cost-effective option compared to getting a real tree.
